independence_evidence: Published by the Milan creative studio C41 itself ('Editorial project by C41.eu'; privacy policy names C41 with registered office in Arcore, MB); no media-group ownership. Issue 19 is made 'in collaboration with Ray-Ban', a sponsored partnership rather than a customer magazine.
qualifies_reason: Independent Milan-based biannual with Issue 19 published 22 June 2026 and Issue 18 in autumn 2025.
what_it_is: C41 is a biannual print magazine from a Milan production studio that mixes photography, design, fashion and visual culture around a single theme per issue; Issue 19 is about tactility and utility in objects and clothes. Issues run to around 300 perfect-bound pages with two alternative covers and long portfolio features. It is aimed at readers of image-led culture magazines and people working in photography and design.

cover_candidates.notes: Square product image on a black background; the cover sits inside it with black margins, so it would need cropping. The cover itself carries the issue details as printed text.
Second cover variant, same square product-image format.

uncertainties: The legal entity behind the magazine is not spelled out: the privacy policy reads 'C41 . with registered offices in Via Tiziano 63 ... 20862 Arcore (MB)' and gives a PEC address for 'k48srl', so the company may be K48 Srl trading as C41. The about page says the studio is based in Milan, Amsterdam and Paris; Milan is recorded. Trim size is not stated on the site. The distributor hint (Issue 18, Oct 2025) is one issue behind.
